title: Co-workers
ref: Bible Study on Women’s Involvement in the Great Commission

sections.title: Bible Study on Women’s Involvement in the Great Commission
paragraphs: How were Spirit-filled women involved in God’s ministry?
What else can we learn about women? (For example: their character, their principles, and how they were treated in the church.)

sections.title: Application
paragraphs: How are the women in your team, group, or church serving at this time?
Share two or three ways, plans, or approaches you could use to encourage the women in your church to grow in serving.
